description: Non-premise registry of exact open derivation obligations. Entries never satisfy dependency closure, never bound or promote downstream rows, and may leave this registry only after a retained derivation closes the named target. The only supplied foundational premise types are axioms and approved primitives in axiom_premise_nodes.json.

ac_orbit_occupancy_statistical_grain_der.label: AC occupancy statistical grain
ac_orbit_occupancy_statistical_grain_der.target: Derive from the retained framework chain whether the physical charged-lepton matter action counts the K/CPT orbit or holomorphic pair once rather than counting each sector or channel.
ac_orbit_occupancy_statistical_grain_der.self_liquidation_condition: A retained kappa/counting-rule theorem deriving this exact grain removes the obligation; until then it blocks dependent closure.

ac_reta_hclass_hunit_readout_derivation_.label: AC R-eta h-class/h-unit readout
ac_reta_hclass_hunit_readout_derivation_.target: Derive from the retained framework chain that the physical charged-lepton readout is the fixed-locus density class, identity-read in h-units as the eta angle, with no extra normalization or transport factor.
ac_reta_hclass_hunit_readout_derivation_.self_liquidation_condition: A retained G3/angle-readout theorem deriving this exact identity removes the obligation; until then it blocks dependent closure.

theta_quark_determinant_cross_sector_rea.label: theta quark-determinant cross-sector readout
theta_quark_determinant_cross_sector_rea.target: Derive whether the charged-lepton K/CPT occupancy carrier is the same physical channel that controls the quark determinant readout and whether that identification forces arg det(M_q)=0.
theta_quark_determinant_cross_sector_rea.self_liquidation_condition: A retained cross-sector determinant-readout theorem removes the obligation; until then it blocks dependent theta closure.
